sloka: जिह्वया परिलिह्यन्तं शोणितं शोणितेक्षणम्।मृद्नन्तं वानरानीकं कालान्तकयमोपमम् ।। ६.६७.१२८ ।।
transliteration: jihvayā parilihyantaṁ śoṇitaṁ śoṇitekṣaṇam।mṛdnantaṁ vānarānīkaṁ kālāntakayamopamam ।। 6.67.128 ।।

translations.english: While falling down, Kumbhakarna was like Mount Meru, shining by his splendour was falling down and knocking down two hundred monkeys.
